accounting_findings: All six trees are charged by lstat allocated blocks; the view links themselves are charged without recursively charging the original 4,548,221,488-byte weight target again.
Persistent artifact/cache/workdir and temporary HLO/NEFF copies are separately accounted; shared-build TMPDIR has the smaller build_auxiliary 256 MiB total and 128 MiB per-file ceilings.
No source proof shows the 1 GiB artifact/file or 3 GiB workdir budget is necessarily inadequate; compiler/intermediate peaks remain unknown.
SDK cache atomic replace/unlock and bucket reset can race v2 scanning. v3 discards incomplete scans and uses finite topology convergence instead of omitting disappeared entries.

limits: Periodic monitoring is not a filesystem hard quota, and compiler growth can occur between observations.
Optional layout compiler cwd remains experiment ROOT; no claim is made that closed native compiler side effects are restricted to the six trees.
HF_HOME=/mnt/nvme/hf is outside the six trees. The inspected fixed local-model path did not establish a mandatory download/write there.
The root preparation snapshot has only 144257024 bytes beyond the 29 GiB requirement; original live resource checks remain necessary.

Unknown cache filenames/version/hostname and unknown workdir branches do not receive the new disappearing-path exception. Workdir internals within the exact known bucket/layout subtree are treated as private compiler topology and require complete rescan convergence.
scope: Read-only SDK/source review plus separately authorized v3 SOURCE/STDLIB MOCK successor; this is not runtime admission.
